correctness.rationale: For each irrational 0<alpha<1, n,k>=1, Sturmian length-n words are the n+1 rotation cells. Interior cut beta_j exchanges 01 and 10 at indices j-1,j, with transposed one of rank ceil(j alpha). Exactly j<=floor(k/alpha) adjacent cuts collapse under k deletions. For distinct separated cells, their greatest crossed interior index J>floor(k/alpha) creates a digit disagreement at J, and floor(J alpha)>=k ensures its survival after k deletions, excluding nonlocal coincidences. Two weight boundary cuts remain; the count follows. The included script passed 11,200 direct comparisons and 320 independently generated orbit-language comparisons. Finite checks alone do not establish the universal theorem.
